sentences.text: 2 CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners files a memo seeking withdrawal of the petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL

In view of Charge sheet filed by the 1st respondent police, the above petition is not maintainable and however the 1st petitioner are already challenged the charge sheet filed by the 1st respondent police in Crime No.07/2025 in Crl.Pet.No.840/2026.
Hence the petitioners may kindly be pleased to permitting them to withdraw the above petition as not pressed in the interest of justice and equity. "
In terms of memo, the petition is disposed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
(M.NAGAPRASANNA) JUDGE SJK List No.: 1 Sl No.: 45 CT:BHK Sri.
